what: The whole full-screen stage (3D canvas · product panel) tilts following the mouse position (−1 to 1 from the screen center) at perspective 900px by ±.9° up/down and ±.9° left/right and is always scaled up slightly to 1.025 — it follows 1 − .92^frame of the remaining distance, so it tilts heavily and with a delay. It returns to center when the mouse leaves the window.

options.scale: Scale kept enlarged, default 1.025 — so edges stay filled even when tilted
options.follow: Share left behind per frame, default .92 — at 0 it follows immediately

from.where: stage.js .fx-stage__tilt — the plate wrapping the original 3D carousel (transformPerspective 900 · scale 1.025 · rotateX −.9y · rotateY .9x · 1 − .92^deltaRatio)

note: Not applied on touch devices or reduced motion. The part uses the element transform, so entrance motion is applied to the outer wrapper
